about.title: Who is Phixalek?
about.lead: Miguel Segura was born in Colombia and is currently pursuing a Multimedia Engineering degree. He moves between [[software development]], [[research in computing and physics]], and personal projects mixing technology with storytelling.
about.body:
He is the creator of **FinBit**, an experimental fintech project built with ((.NET + DDD + Clean Architecture)); and **Bloomink**, his indie studio where he is building *No Witness*, a survival narrative inspired by Resident Evil and Silent Hill using ((UE5 + C++)).

His focus isn’t only shipping — it’s understanding the [[science behind technology]] and turning it into clean, maintainable systems.

Now based in Colombia, he is studying Multimedia Engineering and teaching programming.
bullets: Backend: ((.NET, DDD, Clean Architecture)) → scalable & maintainable systems
Frontend: ((Angular, TypeScript)) → real-world apps with clean UX
Game Dev: ((UE5, C++)) + [[Pixel Art]] → optimized pipelines & storytelling
